findings.title: Duplicate race winner closure and zero authority effects remain incompletely asserted
findings.body: At the exact reviewed SHA the post-race assertions prove cardinality, preservation of previously committed preparation rows, and replay stability, but do not independently reconstruct the newly inserted raced S21/S22 semantic keys, references, provenance and hashes or the raced BUILDING S23 candidate closure. A same-count incorrect dependency or candidate can become the stable new_history baseline and satisfy these assertions. The complete race preserves its prior candidate except the intended READY transition, but the projection/build race winners are not checked with the persisted-source oracle. Also old_history/new_history include only S21/S22/S23, and the final before[1][5:10] comparison omits S01 and receipt/event/outbox. Actual factset seals occur before each race, so a full authority snapshot must be taken after that setup and immediately around each contention. The packet requires exactly one immutable result/dependency closure/build without overwrite and zero unintended publication/authority/bookkeeping effects. The positive pipeline assertions do not establish these properties for the distinct raced rows.
findings.required_change: Independently assert exact persisted semantic/reference/hash closure for each raced winner, including BUILDING and READY candidate states, and compare complete S01/receipt/event/outbox/authority row snapshots immediately before and after each contender phase. Rerun all named checks and fresh reviews on the new tested/result revision.
